This comparison examines the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients based on their anticoagulant treatment status. The data highlights the safety profile of different anticoagulant regimens, specifically comparing [[doac|DOAC]] (referred to as NOAC in the source data), [[marevan]], combination therapy, and no treatment.

Among the treatment groups, patients treated exclusively with [[marevan]] exhibit the lowest proportion of intracranial hemorrhage, with only 0.46% (39 out of 8,534 patients) experiencing a bleeding event [^src1]. In contrast, the highest rate of bleeding is observed in the outlier group receiving a combination of both NOAC and [[marevan]], where 1.41% (21 out of 1,488 patients) suffered an [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] [^src1]. This combination therapy stands out as a significant outlier, presenting a bleeding rate nearly three times higher than that of the monotherapy groups [^src1]. 

Patients receiving neither NOAC nor [[marevan]] show a bleeding rate of 0.54% (152 out of 28,004 patients) [^src1]. The broader category of anticoagulant treatment (AK-behandling), which in this dataset aligns numerically with the NOAC group, shows a bleeding incidence of 0.52% (499 out of 96,784 patients) [^src1]. Because the evidence consists of a single dated section, no longitudinal trends regarding the improvement or decline of these bleeding rates over time can be established.

## Table: AFDK_2023.pdf, p. 98

Rows compare: behandlingstype · Columns show: antal-og-procent

| Behandling | Antal uden blødning | % uden blødning | Antal med blødning | % med blødning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AK-behandling | 96285 | 99.48 | 499 | 0.52 |
| NOAC | 96285 | 99.48 | 499 | 0.52 |
| Marevan | 8495 | 99.54 | 39 | 0.46 |
| Både NOAC og Marevan | 1467 | 98.59 | 21 | 1.41 |
| Hverken NOAC eller Marevan | 27852 | 99.46 | 152 | 0.54 |

Entities: doac, marevan, intrakraniel-bloedning

Summary: Tabellen viser, at intrakraniel blødning forekommer både hos patienter på NOAC, Marevan og uden antikoagulantbehandling, men med lavest andel blandt Marevan-brugere (0,46 %) og højest blandt dem, der modtager både NOAC og Marevan (1,41 %).
